messages:
alex_infra: Heads-up — we have 7 flaky A100s in on-prem eu-west racks after last week's capacity shuffle. Nodes were drained but cards show intermittent Xid spikes during synthetic workloads, want to start RMA + depot swap flow. Need RA and customs guidance. serials below.

maria_hw: paste serials and recent ECC/Xid counts when you have them, will triage for possible thermal or riser issues first.

alex_infra: serials + quick counts: 
```
SN: A100-XYZ-001, xid: 42, ecc_uncorr: 3
SN: A100-XYZ-002, xid: 0, ecc_uncorr: 0
SN: A100-XYZ-003, xid: 19, ecc_uncorr: 1
SN: A100-XYZ-004, xid: 88, ecc_uncorr: 7
SN: A100-XYZ-005, xid: 4, ecc_uncorr: 0
SN: A100-XYZ-006, xid: 120, ecc_uncorr: 12
SN: A100-XYZ-007, xid: 2, ecc_uncorr: 0
```
(These are post-drain results run with the diagnostic harness.)

maria_hw: 4/7 look like hard-fail candidates (001,003,004,006). 002/005/007 okay for now. Please include thermal slides and last 24h powertop.

jamie_ops: Opening vendor ticket now. Need CIF/CO docs and RA number to attach. Depot ETA T+3 once RA is assigned. If customs flags ECC data, that'll slow us.

rma-bot: Vendor ticket created: VND-76321. Waiting on RA from vendor portal.

linda_logistics: For eu customs we need: commercial invoice, packing list, and failure certs. HS code suggestion: 8471.80.50. Courier asks if this is "repair" or "return for credit" — vendor RA decides classification.

rajiv: Spare pool in eu-west is at 22% capacity. Recommend hot-swap 3 cards to restore immediate capacity and batch the other 4 into a QA return manifest next week to avoid multiple customs entries.

mike_eng: Quick reproducible check we run before ship: ```./tools/burnin --card serial=A100-XYZ-006 --duration=30m --stress=fp32``` capture `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=serial,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv` if it fails. Put those logs into the ticket.

alex_infra: Plan: expedite 3 (004,006,001) today for immediate swap (expedite label), hold 004/006 as highest priority. Remaining 4 (including 003) to manifest for depot batch next Tue. I'll run mike_eng's burn-in on 001/003/004/006 now.

alex_infra: Manifest (working draft):
```
RA: PENDING
Item count: 4
Carrier: TBD (expedite for 3)
Serials: A100-XYZ-001, A100-XYZ-003, A100-XYZ-004, A100-XYZ-006
Weight estimate: 18kg total
Dimensions: 45x35x30 cm palletized
Reason: ECC/Xid failures, logs attached
```

linda_logistics: noted. I'll prebook the courier slot and prep commercial invoice template. Please confirm weight/dim by EOD. Also confirm if vendor needs power-on photos.

jamie_ops: RA issued: RA-129487. Vendor assigned depot code EU-DEP-12. Updated ticket VND-76321 with RA and provisional ETA. Label code VND-LBL-009.

maria_hw: Final QA checklist before ship: run 30m burn-in, collect `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi` + kernel oops if any, attach `diag.tar.gz`. If additional Xid events during burn-in mark as "confirmed HW".

alex_infra: Running burn-ins now on the four. Will attach diag bundle and confirm weight. If all goes green for 2/4 we'll still ship 4 but note per-item fail status.

mike_eng: FYI ran the quick probe on 002/005/007 earlier — they show no ECC or Xid growth under 90m stress. Keep those in spares pool.

alex_infra: Thanks all. Will update ticket and drop manifest into the vendor portal once diags are attached. :thumbsup:
